source_structures: PSERS Base Management Fees – External Management
notes: Single-page fee schedule. Column headers read from the page image since the linearised TXT stacks three header lines ambiguously; metric_value_raw and evidence_quote follow the TXT text layer verbatim, spurious mid-number spaces included (e.g. 1 ,494,000), since that is the literal page text the validator checks evidence against. Bottom Grand Total row prints no row label at all and is excluded per the no-label-no-extraction rule; Total Fixed Income IS extracted since it carries its own printed label. US Long Treasuries row is entirely dash/blank and yields no records. The rightmost Peer Universe column names the benchmark source for the Institutional Fee Median figure but is not captured as its own field: basis_raw/text_raw/term_category are schema-illegal on fee_observation (a metric-category family), so that column is left as supporting context inside evidence_quote only. No currency symbol or scale statement is printed anywhere on this page, so currency_scale is left blank throughout rather than inferring USD/thousands.
